ns2:course.label: Intro to Social Psych
ns2:course.description: Systematic study of social factors in individual and group behavior; attention to social perception, motivation, and learning; attitudes, norms, and social influence processes; the development and dynamics of groups; and the effects of social and cultural factors on the individual. Credit is not given for both PSYC 201 and SOC 201. Prerequisite: PSYC 100 or PSYC 103.
